text:
maria: FYI seeing intermittent p99 egress spikes for several tenants on dedicated-grid-eu-west since the 00:20 rollout. Pattern: routing selectors falling back to shared proxy, causing gw tx queues to climb. No GPU memory pressure.

raj: can you paste the route snapshot and an allocator line? thinking selector mismatch or selector precedence change.

ops-bot: ALERT: routing-selector-fallthrough detected pool=dedicated-grid-eu-west severity=high at 2025-02-15T00:44:12Z (auto-ticket INC-9001).

maria: alloc sample: ```alloc=alloc-b37 node=r42 host=gw-03 egress_qdepth=18 tail_p99=462ms route_selector=tag:egress startswith "dedicated" matched=false resolved=shared-proxy```

sophie: startswith? The new egress-route-v2 used prefix selectors for performance. That change can break rules that relied on exact tag equality.

kevin: I deployed egress-route-v2 at 00:15 (eu-wide). If v2 switched from == to startswith that's the cause. rolling the change back in eu now.

kevin: rollback command: ```infractl routes apply --file /ops/egress-route-v1.yaml --region eu-west```

linda: gw-03 NIC counters show tx-queue bursts aligned with the fallback window. `ethtool -S gw-03 | grep tx_queue` spiked at 00:38. Could be packetization amplification when going through shared-proxy shim.

maria: short mitigation options: 1) immediate rollback (kevin) 2) temporary label-based shield on dedicated pools to prefer exact match 3) emergency migrate high-SLO tenants to shared for 2-3h to prevent breaches. What's the cost delta @amy?

amy: migration cost: rough add ~15-25% per-token for heavy inference tenants. If we keep it limited to peak hours and only for 2h, projected delta ~$3.2k for creative-ai and ~1.1k for analytics-sandbox.

raj: starting VIP redirect off gw-03 -> gw-05 to relieve queues. running conntrack drain, should reduce packet backlog in ~2m.

ops-bot: CHANGE: rollback applied in eu-west at 2025-02-15T00:52:03Z.

kevin: observability: infra.egress.tail_p99{pool="dedicated-grid-eu-west"} dropped from ~480ms -> ~30ms within 8m of rollback. No new preempts.

sophie: follow-up actions: - add CI dry-run that validates selector behavior (exact vs prefix) against sample tags - add lint to disallow selector-type changes in a rollout without explicit opt-in - add routing.selector_mismatch_total metric and an alert.

linda: also recommend a small shim test harness in canary clusters to detect packetization amplification when a request path changes from dedicated-egress -> shared-proxy.

maria: agreed. I'll open the post-incident ticket with timeline, attach the route diffs, and schedule a 30m follow-up to land the CI checks and metric. Closing thread unless we see new anomalies. :thumbsup:
